01.question: How does the process start?
01.answer: We begin with a consultation where you show me the garment and describe your vision. I analyze the piece, assess its potential, and suggest transformation options. Then we discuss the concept and agree on the direction.

02.question: How long does upcycling take?
02.answer: Typically 2-4 weeks, depending on the complexity. Simple reconstructions take less time, while complete transformations with new construction require more work. I will give you a timeline after our initial consultation.

03.question: Is it possible to fully change the garment?
03.answer: Yes. Upcycling can range from subtle updates to complete reconstruction. I can change the silhouette, add or remove elements, combine multiple pieces, or create something entirely new while respecting the original fabric and history.

04.question: Do you work with both women's and men's clothing?
04.answer: Yes, I work with all types of garments regardless of original gender categorization. What matters is the quality of the fabric, the construction potential, and your vision for transformation.

05.question: What if the fabric is damaged?
05.answer: Damaged areas can often be incorporated into the new design or removed during reconstruction. Sometimes imperfections become part of the story. I will assess the condition during consultation and suggest the best approach.

hero.title: Nataliia
hero.subtitle: Founder of a design atelier in the style of a fashion house

bio.p1: I am Nataliia Khreshkova — founder and director of a design atelier in the style of a fashion house. Fashion designer, pattern maker. 37 years in the fashion industry.
bio.p2: I create the right clothing as a tool for inner state. Through form, proportions and precise construction, the piece begins to work for the person. It highlights their individuality and status.
bio.p3: A harmonious appearance strengthens and reveals personality.
bio.p4: Every piece is born in dialogue with the person. So clothing becomes a natural part of everyday life and works for the result: for impression, for state and for the expression of personality.
bio.p5: My clients are worldwide. They receive from me individual looks and pieces that help them feel like themselves.
bio.p6: Today I have an author's studio in Germany. And I continue to create clothing with meaning — clothing that reflects the uniqueness of each person.

position.label: Position
position.title: Everyone is unique
position.text1: Everyone is unique by nature. For me, clothing is the balance of inner and outer. Outer image should reflect the depth of personality and become its continuation.
position.text2: Through construction, silhouette and proportions I strengthen individuality and help personality to show. When the outer matches the inner, a state of support and natural wholeness appears.

professional.label: Professional basis
professional.title: Every order begins with dialogue
professional.text1: It is important for me to hear the person — to understand their character, lifestyle and inner rhythm. Even if you find it hard to say exactly what piece you want, I can hear and understand your request.
professional.text2: In the process of working together we find the piece that becomes ideal for you. The work is deep and systematic, in a warm and respectful atmosphere. Every detail in the piece reflects personality and strengthens its expression. My motto: aesthetics, comfort and functionality.

01.title: A system, not a random set
01.description: For me, clothing is not a random set of things. It is a considered system where meaning, function and aesthetics come together. The right piece does not distract from life but helps a person feel appropriate, comfortable and natural in any situation.

02.title: Fashion and awareness
02.description: I respect fashion and trends. However, I believe it is important not to follow them literally but to consciously adapt them to the person, their lifestyle and needs. Only then does clothing become a harmonious part of life and truly work for the result.

process.title: THE PATH OF CREATING YOUR GARMENT
process.subtitle: From the first idea to the final fitting — each stage takes place in personal dialogue, attention to detail and precise professional support.

01.detail: It's not just about creating a piece, but feeling what result it should give.

02.detail: Form, silhouette and character of the garment come from the shared idea. I translate your desires and feelings into a visual image.

03.detail: A precise pattern is created taking into account the particularities of the figure. Construction is the foundation that shapes the fit and freedom of movement.

04.detail: Fabric, trims and thread selection + handwork. Every piece is checked at every stage.

05.detail: We bring the look to wholeness — when the garment becomes a natural extension of you.

process.footer: BESPOKE TAILORING — not just a finished piece. It's an INVESTMENT in an image that works for your state, impression and expression of personality.

quote.text: Clothing is not decoration. It is structure, meaning and personality.
quote.author: NATALIIA KHRESHKOVA

agbPage.title: Terms & Conditions
agbPage.intro: These terms govern the collaboration when ordering NKN atelier services — bespoke tailoring, author's pieces, upcycling and consultations.

order.title: Order and agreements
order.content: An order is confirmed after discussing details and agreeing on terms. Advance payment or deposit is discussed individually depending on the scope of work.

fittings.title: Fittings
fittings.content: For bespoke tailoring, 2–3 fittings are held. Dates are agreed in advance. The client is obliged to attend fittings at the agreed times.

delivery.title: Timelines and delivery
delivery.content: Completion times are indicative and may depend on project complexity and atelier workload. The finished work is handed over after full payment.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content: Payment is made as agreed — in stages or in full. Bank transfer and other methods are accepted by agreement.

returns.title: Returns and alterations
returns.content: Individually made garments cannot be returned. Corrections and adjustments within the agreed scope are carried out by mutual consent.
